tier_a.purpose: Tier A meaningful run: sweep x3 seeds (n=200k), full_structure x3 (n=800k), indistinguishability (n=800k), dynamics
tier_a.result: ~5.8h wall (21036s). Sweep cliff: r1-3 acc=1.00, r4-64 acc=0.50 (all 3 seeds). Full-SHA bounded null: acc~0.500, CI brackets 0.5, MDA-floor~0.0049, controls_ok -> no structure detected. Dynamics: t1=0.354 t2-4=0.25 (chance). All controls pass.

tier_b.purpose: Tier B generous run: finer sweep x5 seeds (n=500k), full_structure x5 (n=4M, ~0.2% null floor), indistinguishability (n=4M), dynamics (n=50k). ~30 CPU-h: exceeds 6h cap, resumes via progress.json across resubmissions.
tier_b.resume_protocol: On 6h SIGTERM the job flushes progress.json + partials; resubmit the same uv-run command against the same bucket to continue. Repeat until summary.json status==complete.
